issue_specific_fields.left_label: MMMM d, yyyy; year may wrap

generation: Reuse the approved image as the edit target; change only date and Roman volume per issue using built-in image generation. No art regeneration for unchanged issues.
email: Use the shared HTML/plain-text exporter with the approved masthead and complete alt text. Retain the baked-in artwork. Follow it with one modest View the web version link (Original published issue for a private historical revision). No extra subject/date wrapper, generic deck, or live H1 full-issue CTA.
preheader: A specific sentence about the actual issue, supplied as email_preheader and Buttondown Description.
body_contract: almanack-v1: actual lead excerpt of 60–100 words, supporting capsules, specific Bob note of at most 50 words, one Worth Reprinting rationale; preserve recurring sections, exact quotations, artwork and source facts.
body_contrast: Pair dark ink #332a22 with cream #f4eddf directly on retained content cells and reader-facing elements, including quote paragraphs, so removing the outer body does not lose text color. Keep blue #346782 links underlined. Retain these fixed pairs in normal and dark provider-wrapper simulations. Local simulations do not verify an actual email client: inspect the approved provider and received preview in light and dark modes before claiming client verification. Keep custom provider CSS disabled and preserve sent emails.
provider_numbering: For each future issue, set Buttondown's per-email Issue number (API secondary_id) to the source canonical issue_number. Metadata alone does not set the footer. Read back the saved draft and require its secondary_id and subject to match the validated export and masthead before preview, scheduling or sending. Stop on a missing number or mismatch. Keep sent emails unchanged; do not rely on a global next counter.
authority: Template approval is not standing authorization to send to subscribers. Weekly workflow remains owner-preview-only until explicit send approval.
sending: Prefer bounded reuse of unchanged editorial checks. Never retry an uncertain subscriber send; inspect status.

local_opt_in_extension.historical_outputs: Fields absent: retain baseline HTML/plaintext and metadata
local_opt_in_extension.distribution: Classic with the existing contrast, numbering, Medium footer and reproducible parity/hash gates
local_opt_in_extension.authority: Local template preparation only; no production asset upload, publication, provider preview, scheduling or subscriber send
